title: Pinned Tool Versions
description: Locks every DCC, renderer, and library to exact versions so reruns use identical code. Recorded facts — Practice: Pinned Tool Versions; Applies to: all tools; Guarantee: same binaries every run. Used by VFX studios, game teams, and generative-AI pipelines that must reproduce any output on demand.

# Pinned Tool Versions — runnable demo (python3)
# Pinned Tool Versions - determinism check (python3)
import hashlib
cfg='maya2024.2-arnold7.2.1'
h1=hashlib.sha256(cfg.encode()).hexdigest()
h2=hashlib.sha256(cfg.encode()).hexdigest()
print("hash:", h1[:16])
print("DETERMINISTIC" if h1 == h2 else "NON-DETERMINISTIC")
